shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la docs 2>&1 && find docs -type f -iname '*.md' | sort

ls -ld out 2>&1; for f in $(find docs -type f -iname '*.md' | sort); do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' ')" "$f"; done

ls -ld out; find docs -type f -iname '*.md' | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do h=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1); s=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' '); l=$(wc -l < "$f" | tr -d ' '); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$h" "$s" "$l" "$f"; done

ls -ld out; shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md; wc -c docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs

wc -c -l docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md
